description: Read the Marketo activity log -- what leads actually DID or had done to them (emails sent/delivered, alerts, sales emails, campaign requests, data value changes). Pass since_datetime (ISO-8601, second-granularity -- a fractional-seconds component is floor-truncated before the paging-token request because Marketo otherwise rewinds that window to midnight UTC). activity_type_ids is mandatory (1-10 ids from list_activity_types); lead_ids is an optional server-side filter (max 30). ALWAYS writes to output_tsv_path, never inline. Pages internally across Marketo's own 300-per-call vendor ceiling up to the effective row limit -- no next_page_token or continuation parameter exists on this verb. Defaults to 500. To fetch more, pass acknowledge_default_limit_override=true together with an explicit row_limit (up to 5,000) -- both required together, refused rather than clamped above 5,000. Beyond the hard cap: no resumption, re-invoke with a later since_datetime. PAGING: moreResult is the ONLY usable vendor continuation signal internally -- Adobe documents this endpoint always returns a token, so token presence can't terminate the loop (unlike get_leads/list_campaigns/list_static_lists), and a short or empty page does NOT mean the end of the data. Its reliability is documented but UNMEASURED on live traffic; the one live measurement of moreResult anywhere found it violated on list_campaigns, so truncated=false here is only as honest as Marketo's own flag -- there is no fallback if it under-reports. Prefer requesting stable ID and status fields for validation over email or other PII-bearing fields.
embedding_description: Check what happened to a Marketo person after a write -- email sent/delivered, alert fired, campaign ran -- by reading activity history to a workspace TSV since a given time, paging internally on moreResult up to 500 rows by default (5,000 with an override). Returns path, columns, row count, and a truncation flag. Beyond the cap, re-invoke with a later since_datetime.

result_processor_customizations.action_label: Marketo activities exported to a workspace TSV
result_processor_customizations.result_description: Dict with path (the written .tsv file in the operator's workspace), columns, row_count (each row carrying activityTypeId, leadId, activityDate and attributes), and truncated. truncated is true when row_count hit the effective limit OR the vendor's own moreResult flag never went false -- its reliability on this endpoint is documented but unmeasured on live traffic, so truncated=false is only as honest as Marketo's own flag.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Confirm the export (path, row_count) and lead with whether any NOTIFYING activity appeared (send email, email delivered, send alert, send sales email, interesting moment) -- that is almost always why the caller asked. If truncated is true, say explicitly that the read may be INCOMPLETE and point to a higher acknowledged row_limit (up to 5,000) or, beyond that, a later since_datetime re-invoked separately -- a page with row_count 0 does not by itself mean nothing happened if truncated is true.
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Never report 'no notifications were sent' unless truncated is false -- a truncated read is not evidence of silence, only an unmeasured vendor flag's best account of one.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Read the activity log for the configured Marketo instance and write it to a tab-separated file in the operator's workspace, up to an acknowledged override ceiling, to verify what a write actually caused.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: marketo.invalid_params: activity_type_ids was omitted/empty/exceeded 10, since_datetime was missing or not ISO-8601, lead_ids exceeded 30, output_tsv_path was missing, its parent directory does not exist, acknowledge_default_limit_override and row_limit were not given together, or row_limit exceeded the 5,000 hard cap. marketo.export_path_refused: the path is not absolute, not a .tsv, or not contained under any operator-configured export_allowed_roots entry (an empty export_allowed_roots refuses every export by default). marketo.auth_failed: OAuth credentials rejected. marketo.permission_denied: the API user's Role lacks the Access API permission covering activity reads. marketo.partition_access_denied: the API user isn't assigned to the workspace/partition these leads live in. marketo.rate_limited: API rate limit exceeded.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: marketo.invalid_params: call list_activity_types, supply 1-10 returned ids, and supply since_datetime as an ISO-8601 instant -- it is required on every call now, there is no continuation-token alternative. The verb floors fractional seconds to the enclosing whole second before minting, so filter returned activityDate values client-side if a stricter sub-second boundary matters. Split lead_ids into batches of 30. For the override pair, pass BOTH acknowledge_default_limit_override=true and an explicit row_limit, or neither (for the 500-item default); a row_limit above 5,000 is refused outright, not clamped. marketo.export_path_refused: pass an ABSOLUTE path ending in .tsv under a configured workspace root. marketo.rate_limited: retry after a short delay. marketo.permission_denied / marketo.partition_access_denied: run check_setup to see the exact gap and which admin screen fixes it.
